# Taha Hamdy — Full-Stack Developer & Systems Architect

> Full-Stack Developer and Systems Architect with 3+ years of experience designing and delivering resilient SaaS platforms, high-throughput e-commerce infrastructure, and real-time business workflows.

## Overview

Taha Hamdy is a full-stack engineer and systems architect based in Alexandria, Egypt. He specializes in TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, and distributed backend architectures.

- [Home Page](https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app/en): Interactive portfolio showcasing engineering projects, technical telemetry, architecture topologies, and system capabilities.
- [Arabic Edition](https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app/ar): Complete localized portfolio with bidirectional RTL layout and native typography.

## Featured Projects & Case Studies

- [Egapy ERP](https://www.egapy.com/ar): Enterprise Resource Planning solution for operational automation, multi-branch inventory, invoicing, and real-time analytics. Built with Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. (Live in Production)
- [Labaik Platform](https://labaikapp.com/ar): Digital service connecting individuals with verified delegates for Umrah-al-Badal. Includes a public portal, administrative dashboard, and real-time notification pipeline. (Live in Production)
- [Ecombo](https://ecombo.co/ar): Leading e-commerce logistics platform in the UAE & Saudi Arabia, providing cloud warehousing, packaging, and zero-capital business launching. Built with React.js. (Live in Production)
- [Nazam Commerce Platform](https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev/nazam): Commerce operations suite unifying multi-channel inventory, automated catalog synchronization, and distributed order processing. (Monorepo Architecture / Private)
- [Buy From Egypt](https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev): B2B export platform connecting Egyptian exporters with global buyers, integrated with an AI/ML conversational model. (Private Showcase)
- [Coldwell Banker — New Alex](https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev/cold-well-banker): Real estate discovery platform with property filtering and interactive maps. (Formerly Live · Now Offline)
- [GEDO](https://github.com/TahaHamdy-MernDev/GEDO): Alzheimer's care management system helping caregivers manage medication, health tracking, and patient monitoring. (Open Source Repository)

## Technical Skills & Architecture

- [Frontend Capabilities](https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app/en#skills): TypeScript, React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router), Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP, State Management, Responsive & Adaptive UI.
- [Backend Engineering](https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app/en#skills): Node.js, NestJS, Express, GraphQL, REST APIs, BullMQ Job Queues, Event-Driven Architecture.
- [Data & Storage](https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app/en#skills): PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, TypeORM, Redis (Caching & PubSub), MongoDB.
- [Infrastructure & DevOps](https://taha-hamdy.vercel.app/en#skills): Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, Linux Server Administration, Turborepo, Vercel, Turbopack.
